Services

# Silk wallcovering installation

Silk wallcoverings, plain and patterned, hung in London houses and hotels.

[Request a quotation](https://www.mrwallcover.com/contact/?service=wallcovering&topic=service%3Asilk-wallcovering-installation) [See the work](https://www.mrwallcover.com/projects/)

Silk is lustrous, and quick to mark. It is hung with clean hands and an adhesive that suits the cloth. Seams are planned so the light from the windows does not catch a ridge.

The wall has to be right first. Preparation, including a lining where the maker specifies one, is written into the scope.

Protection of floors, furniture and finished joinery is part of the hang, not an optional extra.

![Close-up of a blue-grey hand-dyed Fromental silk, Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/fs-ig-11-800.webp)

Blue-grey hand-dyed Fromental silk at [Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square](https://www.mrwallcover.com/projects/four-seasons-ten-trinity-square/). A photograph records the installed surface; a physical sample decides colour and sheen.Photograph: Mr Wallcover.

01

## Why silk is unforgiving

Silk has a cloth face with a sheen that changes as you move. It marks quickly: adhesive on the face, or a ridge at a seam, shows in raking light and cannot be wiped away. Its care is the maker's note, usually dry. It is not a corridor vinyl, and it is specified for rooms where light is part of the finish.

02

## The wall decides the finish

A textured grasscloth forgives small undulations that a silk will show. Where the specification includes it, preparation means stripping old paper, sanding with dust extraction, and making good cracks and uneven surfaces before anything decorative goes up. Period walls can take days of filling and sanding before they are true.

Fresh plaster and filler need time to dry, and a moisture reading, not a calendar date, is the proof. Whether the wall is lined is the maker's call; where a lining is used, its joints never coincide with the joints of the silk, and it is dry first. The primer or size is the one the product's instruction names. The [wall preparation guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wall-preparation/) covers each check.

03

## Seams, light and set-out

Seams are planned so the light from the windows does not catch a ridge. Pattern is set out from the room's focal points, such as chimneypieces, doorcases and bed walls, so the design meets the cornice and the joinery with composure. Deliveries are checked against the measure, and batches and shading are managed so that a room reads as one surface.

Silk is hung with clean hands and an adhesive that suits the cloth, and floors, furniture and finished joinery are protected as part of the hang.

04

## Silks and textiles on the record

At [Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square](https://www.mrwallcover.com/projects/four-seasons-ten-trinity-square/), the hotel wallcoverings of 2019, about 5,000 m², included Fromental silks, alongside Dedar, Vescom, Tektura and Muraspec. At [Raffles London at The OWO](https://www.mrwallcover.com/projects/raffles-london-the-owo/), selected suites have Vescom Alcantara.

Before a silk is ordered, see the sample in the room's own light and confirm the preparation and care it needs; the [silk and textiles](https://www.mrwallcover.com/materials/silk-and-textiles/) material page has the checklist.

05

## What the quotation includes

There is no flat rate per roll. The quotation comes from a site survey or from drawings, and reflects the measured area after openings are taken off, the pattern repeat and the wastage it creates, the state of the walls, lining where it is specified, and access and protection. The [installation cost guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/installation-cost/) explains each item. We focus on whole residences and hotel packages, and will take on one- or two-room commissions.

Questions

## Asked about Silk wallcovering installation

Illustrative material studies

Pause motion

### Is silk wallpaper hard to install?

It is unforgiving. Adhesive on the face or a ridge at the seam shows in raking light. That is why the set-out, the adhesive and the preparation are planned before the first length.

### Who is responsible if free-issue material is faulty, short or damaged?

Free-issue deliveries are checked against the measure when they arrive. Scenic panels are checked dry against the layout before any paste and before anything is cut, so a sequence, sizing or print problem comes to light while it is still easy to resolve. Quantities are ordered to cover the repeat and the wastage, typically 15–30% and around 30% on staircases, so that the last wall doesn't wait. The specification should say who orders, who receives and checks the delivery, and who approves the batch. The twelve-month guarantee covers the workmanship of the hang: seams opening, edges lifting and adhesive failure that comes from the way the material was hung. Rolls are inspected as part of preparation, although on large volumes not every roll can be opened in advance. Any defect is reported straight away to the designer, the contractor and the manufacturer. If a fault comes from the installation, Mr Wallcover covers the cost of the material.

### How do you price, and what does it cost?

There is no flat rate per roll. The quotation comes from a site survey or from drawings. It reflects the measured area after openings are taken off, the pattern repeat and the wastage it creates (typically 15–30%, with staircases around 30%), the state of the walls, the material, and access and protection. Access, protection and making good are written into the scope rather than discovered at the end, and the quotation says what has been allowed for. The site publishes no prices.

### Do you take on single rooms, or only larger projects?

We focus on whole residences and hotel packages, and will take on one- or two-room commissions.

### What aftercare and guarantee are included?

Aftercare is part of every commission: a return inspection about four to six weeks after completion, a priority repair call-out and a twelve-month workmanship guarantee.
